name: Crushing Pressure
body:
School transmutation; Level antipaladin 3, bloodrager 3, inquisitor 3, magus 3, psychic 3, sorcerer/wizard 3, summoner 3, witch 3
Duration 5 rounds + 1 round/level (max 10)

DESCRIPTION

This spell functions as lesser crushing pressure except it deals 2 bludgeoning damage per round and the damage is no longer subject to DR.
